import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen as G
n=int(sys.argv[1]); seed0=int(sys.argv[2])
reqs=[G.gen(seed0+i) for i in range(n)]
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(json.loads(l)["status"] for l in lines)
print(c)
# magnitude of certificate entries
mx=0; mxd=0
for l in lines:
    r=json.loads(l)
    if r["status"]=="infeasible":
        mx=max(mx, max(abs(v) for v in r["certificate"]["inequality"]), max((abs(v) for v in r["certificate"]["equality"]), default=0))
    else:
        mxd=max(mxd, max(abs(v) for v in r["dual"]["inequality"]), max((abs(v) for v in r["dual"]["equality"]), default=0))
print("max |infeasible cert|", mx, "max |dual|", mxd)
PYEOF
